<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>cmdb_ci_appl_generic</ci_type><cpattern_type>2</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>0a4cee46c34ab610982a7d0ed40131ea</metadata_id><name>Proxmox LXC detection</name><ndl>library {
	name = "Proxmox LXC detection"
	id = "0a4cee46c34ab610982a7d0ed40131ea"
	description = "Proxmox LXC detection"
	step {
		name = "Detect if we're running in a container"
		runcmd_to_var {
			cmd = "[ -e /dev/.lxc-boot-id ] && echo 'lxc'"
			execution_mode = "DEFAULT"
			var_names = "container_type"
			parsing_strategy = delimited_parsing {
				selected_positions = 1
			}
			if_not_found_do = terminate {}
			cache_flag = 0
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Set manufacturer and model"
		transform {
			src_table_name = "cmdb_ci_linux_server"
			target_table_name = "cmdb_ci_linux_server"
			operation {
				set_field {
					field_name = "manufacturer"
					value = "LXC"
				}
				set_field {
					field_name = "model_id"
					value = concat {
						"Containerized "
						get_attr {"cmdb_ci_linux_server[1].os"}
					}
				}
				set_field {
					field_name = "virtual"
					value = "true"
				}
			}
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Get /etc/appliance.info"
		comment = "If we get the desired answer, it will be a multi-line text. We don't want to parse it, test for value will be in next step."
		runcmd_to_var {
			cmd = "[ -e /etc/appliance.info ] && cat /etc/appliance.info || echo 'Not found'"
			execution_mode = "DEFAULT"
			var_names = "SystemVariable"
			parsing_strategy = empty_strategy {}
			if_not_found_do = nop {}
			cache_flag = 0
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Set comments"
		if {
			condition = not_contains {
				get_attr {"SystemVariable"}
				"Not found"
			}
			on_true = set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_linux_server[*].comments"
				get_attr {"SystemVariable"}
			}
			on_false = nop {}
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Get /etc/machine-id"
		runcmd_to_var {
			cmd = "[ -e /etc/machine-id ] && cat /etc/machine-id"
			execution_mode = "DEFAULT"
			var_names = "serial_number"
			parsing_strategy = delimited_parsing {
				selected_positions = 1
			}
			if_not_found_do = nop {}
			cache_flag = 0
		}
	}
	step {
		name = "Set serial number"
		set_attr {
			"cmdb_ci_linux_server[*].serial_number"
			get_attr {"serial_number"}
		}
	}
}
</ndl><parent/><serverless>false</serverless><source/><sys_class_name>sa_pattern</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>karel.benes</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-27 20:47:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0a4cee46c34ab610982a7d0ed40131ea</sys_id><sys_mod_count>28</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Proxmox LXC detection</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sa_pattern_0a4cee46c34ab610982a7d0ed40131ea</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>karel.benes</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-03-14 06:01:52</sys_updated_on><version/></sa_pattern></record_update>
